name: proxmox_metrics_silent

query_condition.sql: SELECT max(_timestamp) AS last_seen FROM "proxmox_node_uptime" HAVING max(_timestamp) < cast(to_unixtime(now()) AS bigint)*1000000 - 600000000

description: SMS si le serveur de metriques OpenTelemetry de Proxmox n'a plus rien envoye depuis 10 minutes

name: proxmox_storage_usage_high
description: SMS si un stockage Proxmox depasse 85% d'occupation

name: proxmox_node_memory_high
description: SMS si la memoire de l'hote Proxmox hors cache ZFS ARC depasse 90%

name: proxmox_node_cpu_high

query_condition.sql: SELECT avg(value) AS cpu FROM "proxmox_node_cpustat_cpu" HAVING avg(value) > 0.9

description: SMS si le CPU de l'hote Proxmox est en moyenne au-dessus de 90% pendant 15 minutes

name: proxmox_guest_restarted

query_condition.sql: SELECT name, vmid, min(value) AS uptime FROM "proxmox_vm_uptime" WHERE value > 0 GROUP BY name, vmid HAVING min(value) < 600

description: SMS si une VM ou un conteneur Proxmox a redemarre (uptime sous 10 minutes, les invites arretes sont ignores)

name: proxmox_backup_failed

query_condition.sql: SELECT _timestamp, pve_backup_event, pve_vmid, body_message FROM "proxmox" WHERE pve_backup_event IN ('job_failed','vm_failed')

description: SMS si une sauvegarde vzdump Proxmox echoue (job ou invite)

name: proxmox_backup_missing

query_condition.sql: SELECT ok, first FROM (SELECT min(_timestamp) AS first, sum(CASE WHEN pve_backup_event = 'job_ok' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ok FROM "proxmox") WHERE ok = 0 AND first < cast(to_unixtime(now()) AS bigint)*1000000 - 86400000000

description: SMS si aucune sauvegarde vzdump Proxmox terminee avec succes depuis 26 heures (ne s'arme qu'apres 24 heures de logs dans le stream)

name: proxmox_task_failed

query_condition.sql: SELECT _timestamp, pve_component, pve_task_type, pve_vmid, pve_task_status FROM "proxmox" WHERE pve_task_failed = true

description: SMS si une tache Proxmox se termine en erreur (inclut le renouvellement ACME quotidien acmerenew tant qu'il echoue)

name: proxmox_auth_failed_burst

query_condition.sql: SELECT _timestamp, pve_user, pve_client_ip, pve_component FROM "proxmox" WHERE pve_auth_result = 'failure'

description: SMS si au moins 5 echecs d'authentification Proxmox en 15 minutes
